name: smoking_two_faces
about: Smoking Behind the Supermarket story Short: burnt-out salaryman Sasaki lives for cashier Yamada's smile; behind the store the punk smoker Tayama waves him over - he never realises they are the same girl. The drop cuts between her two faces; he ends telling Tayama how much he admires Yamada.
anime: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
song: /mnt/datadisk/song/Illusionary Daytime x 室内系 TrackMaker Extended Edit Version Slowe.mp3

story.why: Sasaki: Yamada from register two, my ray of light at the end of a long work day
Sasaki: since when did us smokers lose all our rights? / Tayama: hey, pops, over here
Tayama: don't just stand there, sit and have a smoke

outro.why: Sasaki to Tayama: I wish I could keep going with a smile the way Yamada does

hook_text: He has no idea it's the *same girl*...
title: He Doesn't Know The Punk Girl He Smokes With Is His FAVORITE Cashier
hook: Sasaki lives for the cashier's smile. He also smokes with a punk girl out back every night. Same girl. He has no idea.
